milestones.label: Applications open for the 2027/28 call (embassy notices)
milestones.source_text: Chinese embassy notices dated 23 to 30 October 2026 (for example Indonesia, Maldives, Timor-Leste and South Sudan) state that applications for the 2027/28 Chinese Government Scholarship are open; no single worldwide opening day is given.

milestones.label: Application deadline depends on the route (Type A: country; Type B: host university)
milestones.time_text: set by each embassy or university
milestones.source_text: Embassies and consulates set separate closing dates for the 2027/28 Type A call, and each host university sets its own date for Type B. Official examples follow.

milestones.label: Application deadline (route example: Indonesia, embassy route, 2027/28 call)
milestones.source_text: Official notice of the Chinese embassy in Indonesia (27 October 2026) says online applications for the 2027/28 year must be in before 14 February 2027; the embassy then forwards recommended files to the China Scholarship Council between 15 February and 1 March 2027, and results are checked in July to August 2027. Other countries set their own dates.

milestones.label: Application deadline (route example: Maldives, embassy route, 2027/28 call)
milestones.source_text: Official notice of the Chinese embassy in the Maldives (25 October 2026) gives 29 January 2027 as the closing date for the 2027/28 year and says applications are already open.

milestones.label: Application deadline (route example: Canada, Montreal consulate route, 2027/28 call)
milestones.source_text: Official notice of the Chinese Consulate General in Montreal (5 November 2026) gives 10 February 2027 as the online closing date for Canadian citizens applying through Type A.

milestones.label: Application deadline (route example: Timor-Leste, ministry route, 2027/28 call)
milestones.source_text: Official notice of the Chinese embassy in Timor-Leste (23 October 2026) says applications and documents must reach the Timorese higher-education ministry before 20 December 2026.

milestones.label: Application deadline (Type B example: Peking University, 2027 entry)
milestones.source_text: Peking University's international students office gives 25 December 2026 as the closing date of its graduate application, which includes scholarship consideration.

milestones.label: Application deadline (Type B example: Zhejiang University, doctoral)
milestones.source_text: Zhejiang University's International College gives 31 December 2026 for the university route of the Chinese Government Scholarship.
